objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has embedded VBScript components in LNK files to download additional files and automate collection.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also used VBA macros in maldocs to execute malicious DLLs.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) also utilized a VBS Script “autorun.vbs” that created persistence through saving the VBS Script in the startup directory which would cause it to run each time the machine was turned on.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)
objects.description_fa: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) مؤلفه‌های VBScript را در فایل‌های LNK برای دانلود فایل‌های اضافی و جمع‌آوری خودکار جاسازی کرده است. همچنین از ماکروهای VBA در فایل‌های مخرب برای اجرای DLL‌های مخرب استفاده کرده است. در.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023) (Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019) (Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019) (Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018) (Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)
